default.description: Default capability for the main window.

remote-ipc.description: Remote-origin IPC (localhost only) for injected shell features: the quit-confirmation dialog, external-links handler and context-menu actions (open_url / open_devtools / quit_app). The dsh web UI is served over http://127.0.0.1:PORT, so its origin is remote to Tauri; without this capability the injected scripts could not reach the shell commands.
